_refresh: Before rendering: capture fresh shots; refresh the LIVE numbers on the explorer scene from /explorer; the advance scene shows the record page's take-advance card.

scenes.title: Sage — an AI agent that moves money on verified work.
scenes.sub: Future Caribbean · Finance, Payments & MSME Capital · sagepays.xyz

scenes.title: Give it a budget and an outcome.
scenes.caption: it inspects, designs the work, verifies every deliverable, pays — and no one at the organization touches a dashboard

scenes.title: One door. Two human moments: say the work, fund it.
scenes.caption: an email is enough on both sides — Sage keeps the wallets and pays the gas

scenes.title: "J$10,000 in two equal parts."
scenes.caption: priced in the region's own currency at a stamped rate, split in exact base units — no model computes a money amount

scenes.title: Fund once. The agent launches every campaign from a treasury.
scenes.caption: a mandate caps each campaign; unspent money can only return to the founder

scenes.title: The agent's work, on one screen.
scenes.caption: open work, what it verified, what it paid, what it refused — receipt by receipt

scenes.title: Every payout cites its evidence and anchors to a transaction.
scenes.caption: the vault sets the amount, enforces caps, refuses replays — the AI proposes, the vault disposes

scenes.title: Every settlement. Every refusal.
scenes.caption: LIVE: $63.60 settled · 41 payouts · 26 refused — the refusals are the institutional asset

scenes.title: The farm that took a whole gig — and what now stops it.
scenes.caption: wallet clusters and copies are held or revoked in a finalization window the agent runs itself; zero wrong auto-pays across the promotion batteries

scenes.title: Every payout is a row in someone's credit record.
scenes.caption: a fee of $0.10 per settlement instead of 7–9% · settlement in seconds · a record a lender can read

scenes.title: The Sage Advance: working capital against verified inflow, no collateral.
scenes.caption: published arithmetic on witnessed inflow, repaid from the next verified payout — the facility works, the LP is us

scenes.title: Underwrite from the tape, not the story.
scenes.caption: one JSON endpoint per record · linked wallets across rails · selective disclosure on request

scenes.title: Intent → verify → pay → record → capital.
scenes.sub: The agent runs the loop. Open source · live on two mainnet rails · sagepays.xyz
